summary: Iter82: ema_test immune to AI review + executed 3×ATR safety SL (paper/real/backtest) + 'pips' everywhere. New suite tests/test_iter82_safety_sl_pips.py: 18/18 PASS (-n 0). (a) review_open_positions: only-cross → [] with no LLM call and no kline fetch; cross+normal → only normal reviewed. (b) ema_test SL = close ∓ 3×ATR (== _atr_levels), reasons[1] has 'SL de seguridad'. (c) paper monitor long/short: price beyond SL → close_position(id, p.sl, 'SL') + RISK log; inside → mark/unrealized updated; beyond virtual TP → not closed, no partial/BE. (d) REAL: broker.open gets float sl (distance preserved after slippage) and tp None. (e) backtest: violent df → SL trades, no TP; smooth → all CRUCE. (f) pips_for examples (22 / -125 / 150), Trade.from_mongo w/o pips computes, explicit kept, Position recomputed from mark. API: /api/fx/dashboard trades XAUUSD -50.0 / EURUSD 20.0 pips; /api/dashboard, /api/trades, /api/fx/trades include pips; POST /api/backtest ema_test UNIUSDT 5m → 200, reasons {CRUCE}. Frontend: /hotforex Historial '= -50 pips' / '= +20 pips' with PIPS_HINT tooltip; detail dialog 'Recorrido en pips' = '-50 pips'; CSV header has 'Pips' with -50 / 20. /bybit: temp cross position shows 'Cruce EMAs Especial' badge and position-pips '+3817,5 pips' (correct for live mark 4.946 vs entry 8, short), BUT SL column still shows '— cruce' and badge tooltip still says 'sin SL/TP'.
